scene hall_noon
We’re now merely two hours away from what will be a complete week since Makoto got the news about her father.
Oh, and I guess Nodoka got her ass kicked as well- but that sort of pales in comparison to the emotional rollercoaster I was forced onto just minutes later.
Since then, things have calmed down a little.
Yumi was “indefinitely suspended” for attacking a fellow student.
Nodoka’s black eyes have started to fade back to their usual color.
Even Yasu has returned to normal.
Or...at least as normal as Yasu can possibly be.

I also have no idea how I would have survived this last week without Imani (Who seems to have forgiven me following the Yumi incident) seeing as she’s taken over all the clerical stuff in Makoto’s absence.
The only person who really hasn’t shown any sign of improvement yet is Miku...
Who, understandably, is decaying from the inside out knowing that the beautiful mind of her best friend is rotting away in a dark room several miles from here.
It’s a room that she’s spent far more time in than me.
It’s a room that she’s brave enough to return to while I would sooner slip back into the shadows and pretend none of this ever happened.
But every time I look at Makoto’s desk, that wishful illusion is suffocated out of existence.
And every time I watch her friend reflexively shift her gaze over to it to try and convince herself this was all just some horrible dream, the truth is reinforced.
scene black
But that’s just the way it goes, I guess.
Sometimes, bad things happen to good people.
More often than not, it seems like this pattern not only continues, but aggressively ramps up with each passing day.
Sometimes, bad things won’t stop happening to good people.
And while I wish that I could take these words to heart and truly feel something reminiscent of sympathy for the good person in question-
I am one of those bad things.
And it would make no sense at all for me, burdened by my constant obsession with navel-gazing, to slight them when I am of that same ilk.
I’ll remain quiet.
I will wait.
And I will only moderately taint those that come to me with their concerns.
scene makotoback1
And I will only moderately taint those that come to me with their concerns...
: Mornin’, Sensei.
: Good morning, Miku. Are you feeling any better?
: Not really. Was actually plannin’ on askin’ ya if I could maybe leave early today.
: You don’t need to ask. You can leave literally whenever you want.
: I’m honestly surprised you’re coming at all given everything that’s happened.
scene makotoback2
: I’d feel too bad ditchin’ swim club when two of the members ain’t comin’ to school right now and one of em’s still too sore to actually do anything.
: Karin’s finally a captain, too. Bailin’ and leavin’ her with just one other girl would be way too rude.
: I think Karin’s mature enough to understand that you might want a little time away right now.
scene makotoback3
: It’s fine, Sensei. Really. Gettin’ some exercise is good for me right now anyway. Helps get my mind off of stuff.
: Sorry we ain’t been spendin’ much time together lately, though. All my free time’s been goin’ to Makoto and...yeah.
: How is she?
scene makotoback4
: She ain’t changed much. Still really sad and...sayin’ a bunch of things that don’t make much sense to me.
: She’s bein’ a little nicer to Maki, though. Hasn’t really yelled at her lately.
scene makotoback3
: That wouldn’t have somethin’ to do with your little visit there, would it?
if makotolust30 == True:
: Heard you were able to take Makoto’s mind off of stuff for almost a whole day.
: How’d ya do it? Lettin’ me and Maki in on your secret technique might be able to get her up and at ‘em again a little bit sooner.
: I...think it’s best if my technique remains hidden.
else:
: You mean when I went into her room and tried having an actual conversation with her only for her to throw it back in my face?
: I left before anything even happened. I doubt Makoto’s sudden change of heart has anything to do with me.
: Well, I obviously wasn’t there, so I’ve got no idea what actually went down. But I think it’s clear as day that you showin’ up definitely helped at least a little.
: Fact is, even if she didn’t seem like it at the time, Makoto loves ya. There ain’t no way she’d actually be mad about you tryin’ to be there for her.
: Whatever the case, I hope she comes back soon. Class is weird without her.
scene makotoback5
: It really is, ain’t it?!
: I know we’re already pretty disorganized, but without Makoto actually givin’ people work to do, the whole heckin’ class has turned to chaos!
: I’m gettin’ dumber by the day, Sensei! And I was already in last place to begin with! I can’t afford this.
scene makotoback6
: Well, I can’t say I’ll be as much help as her...but I guess I could try actually teaching you for a little while each day until she comes back.
scene makotoback7
: Anything involving math, though, you're probably better off asking Imani. She’s a lot better at-
: Makoto?...
: What?
scene makotoback8
: Guess who’s back, bitches.
: Makoto, what the heck are you doin’ here?! There ain’t no way you’re ready for this yet!
: I think it might be time to cash in on that “going home early” thing, Miku. Take Makoto home before-
scene makotoback9
: Guys...guys! I’m fine! I was able to dress myself and everything.
: Besides, if I spend any longer inside of that room, I’m going to go fucking insane.
scene makotoback10
: So, what’s new? Is Nodoka dead too? Is Yumi still a fucking bitch?
: Has Sensei been completely fucking worthless without me here to do everything for him?
: Or is shit pretty much the same?
: Makoto...
: What’s wrong? Taken aback by the fact that I’m now engaging in schoolgirl gossip rather than shunning it and burying my face in a fucking notebook instead?
: Spit it out, Miku. Tell me how much has changed.
: Tell me how much happier everyone is without me here.
scene makotoback11
: Well, that’s...certainly a look for her.
: I wonder what happened?
: It’s not like Makoto to be anything less than perfect...and this sudden shift in aesthetic has made whatever the situation is impossible for me to ignore any longer.
: You haven’t heard anything from Sensei, have you?
scene makotoback12
: Ami?
scene makotoback13
: Okay! Since Miku didn’t have anything to say...how about you, Sensei?
: I haven’t seen you since my mom dragged you all the way to my fucking house to try and manipulate me into not being sad anymore.
: That’s not what happened, Makoto.
: Hmm...I guess that can be kind of subjective, yeah.
: But something that definitely did happen is you knocking one of my dad’s pictures off the wall and shattering it into a million pieces.
if makotolust30 == True:
: Was the mark you left on me not enough back then? You had to leave one on my fucking hallway too?
else:
: Just couldn’t go home without leaving your mark, huh?
: Did you know that a shard of glass managed to cut right through my dad’s neck in that picture? Do you have any idea how fucking hysterical that is?
: I don’t even care that it was my favorite picture of us. That was genuinely hilarious.
: Can the picture be replaced?
: With what? Wanna hang one up of yourself?
: You know that’s not what I meant...
: Ooh! Maybe we can take one as a family! You can put your arm around me. I can look up at you with childish admiration in my eyes.
: And then you could go into space and fucking suffocate because my life sucks and things like that just happen to me now.
scene makotoback14
: Um...Ayane?...
: I know she’s kind of far away, but...you didn’t just hear what Makoto said...did you?
: I’ve never been so upset to have good hearing before...
: That poor girl...I can’t even imagine how that must feel.
: Is...Is there something we can do?...
: I have no idea...
: And I’d say that the best thing we can do while we figure that out is to pretend we didn’t hear anything, but...
: I think that is about to become impossible.
scene makotoback15
: Makoto! Stop it! You don’t have to come back to school yet! There’s no rush at all!
: Let’s...let’s go to the dorm! We can be alone there and I can tell ya all about how much school has sucked without you here!
: Senpai! I know you told me to stay in our office until I finished with all of your paperwork. But I just got a call from Makoto’s mom and-
: Oh, fuck.
: Attention, please!
: Senpai, what do we do? Her mom doesn’t even know she’s here right now. She told me she went missing.
: Let’s...
: Let’s let her talk...
: I said ATTENTION PLEASE!
: I know this isn’t the beginning of the school year anymore and that this is a really weird time to do this, but I’d like to take this opportunity to get to meet all of you!
: My name is Makoto Miyamura and my dad is fucking dead.
: Holy shit...
: Oh, no...
: I was really hoping...it wouldn’t be anything like that...
scene makotoback16
: I know that none of you have ever fucking cared about me, so this might just sound annoying, but I’d also like all of you to know that you won’t have to be annoyed by me any longer!
: Because I don’t fucking care anymore!
scene makotoback17
: Schoolwork?! Studying?! Why waste time on things like that when life is finite and could be stripped from you at any moment?!
: What’s the point of striving to become better when it’s all for fucking nothing in the end?!
: In fact, what’s the point of living at all when it’s just constant stress and suffering and pain with liiiiiittle tiny bits of the good shit sprinkled on top?!
: We do care about you, Makoto! Of course we care!
: Chika’s right! If you need anyone to talk to, we-
: BZZZZZZZZZZZZT! THE ANSWER IS THERE IS NO FUCKING POINT.
: Of course you’re going to act like you care now. Fucking look at me. You’d have to be fucking heartless  to ignore a girl giving a speech about her dead fucking dad.
: But where were you before this?
: Where was fucking anyone other than Miku while I was suffering alone in my room?
: Which isn’t to say that any of you showing up would have fucking helped me. But it really would have been the nice thing to do, right?
: Like...I don’t know. Maybe a fucking card?
: They didn’t know, Makoto! We didn’t tell anyone because we thought it was too soon!
scene makotoback18
: TOO SOON?!
: My world is fucking exploding right now and you think it’s “too soon?!” For what?!
: Hey, don’t take your anger out on Miku! She’s been miserable all week long worrying about you!
scene makotoback19
: I’m not taking anything out on anyone! In fact, you’re all pretty fucking great! It’s no wonder you haven’t bothered with me!
scene makotoback20
: I annoy you, right?
: You hate that I’m the one who forces you out of what should be seven hours of pure fun and relaxation...
: You hate that you can’t spend all of your time with Sensei because I’m constantly making him spend time with me instead...
: You hate the worksheets. And the quizzes. And the message board. And all of the other stuff I put together because something inside of me made me feel like I had to make my daddy proud one day.
: And that if he saw how smart and responsible I’d become...that he’d be able to die happy.
scene makotoback21
: But, instead...
: He just died.
: And now I’ll never know if he was happy or not.
scene makotoback22
: But, I’ll tell you one thing I do know...
: It's that I sure as fuck won’t ever be.
: There’s nothing left for me to work for.
: No reason to keep trying so hard for a bunch of people who see me for who I really am.
: An incorrigible...irritating...loud mouthed bitch.
: Just like my mother.
scene makotoback23
: Are you really sure we should be letting her ramble on like this? She’s clearly out of it and this is, like...reputation suicide.
: Maybe that’s what she wants?
: Senpai...
: Who says starting over has to be a bad thing?
: No one. I’m not saying that. I just think that we should maybe wait until she’s...oh, I don’t know- not running away from home and giving speeches to the class while cosplaying as a fucking zombie.
: I just don’t want her going out in some blaze of glory while everybody else sits back and watches.
: Who says everyone’s just sitting back and watching?
: Senpai, what are you talking about? Are we not seeing the same thing right now?
: Stop staring at me and take a look for yourself.
scene makotoback24
: Shut up...
: Shut up...shut up...shut up...
: Hearing you say those things...
: It brings back too many bad memories...
scene makotoback25
Sometimes, all it takes to reduce the suffering is someone you can relate to.
Someone who climbs out of the woodwork and into your arms...that you can abhor in moments of joyous splendor and admire in stretches of constant pain.
I let her speak because I knew this would happen.
I knew it from the moment I saw Ami’s face.
Because Ami is a girl I have cherished and loved.
She is a girl I understand.
And Makoto?
Makoto will become one of those too.
But for now, she needs to suffer.
For now, she needs to cry.
scene makotoback26
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
: Uhh...okay! If your name isn’t Makoto, Ami, Miku, or Sensei, please leave the room right now! We’re going to have class in the gym or something!
: I actually think Miss Watabe’s class is in the gym right now.
: Then it looks like we’re having a joint period! Go, go, go!
scene black
The girls filter out of the room paying minimal attention to what’s happening in the front of the class despite a burning interest to act in opposition to that.
Imani is the last one out, sliding the door closed after locking eyes with me and silently admitting that sometimes I can, whether it be intentional or not, actually know what needs to be done.

Those moments are few and far between. And frankly, this moment isn’t even one of triumph for me as all I did was clear a path for the only person actually able to do anything when it comes to pain like this.
scene makotoback27
: Never say you won’t ever be happy again! It’s a lie! A lie I told myself over and over when this happened to me!
: Ami’s right! This’ll sting forever, but there’s plenty more good stuff out there! Good stuff I wanna see and experience with my best friend!
: You think we woulda made it as far as we did if we just gave up?!
: Yes, you’re annoying! Yes, I hate the stupid worksheets! And yes, I kinda hate you when you spend every day trying to steal my uncle away from me!
: But I’d never wish this sort of pain on anybody in the whole wide world!
scene makotoback28
: And you need to know that life goes on.
: Ami...
: There isn’t a day that goes by where I don’t miss my parents. I can’t even cross the street without having to force back tears.
: But Sensei makes me happy now! And you still have your mom!
: Let her be that for you! Stop closing yourself off and let her make you happy instead!
: That’s what your dad would have wanted, isn’t it?!
: Wouldn't he have wanted you to be happy?!
scene makotoback29
: But...
: It’s so hard!
: I can’t stop thinking about him! About what his final thoughts must have been! About how I never got to say goodbye!
: I know it’s hard! But it'll only get easier from here, Makoto! So don’t give up just yet!
: Keep being the same annoying you! Because even if we’re not there for you all the time and forget to make cards when things are horrible, we do care!
: And we can cry together when no one else understands our pain!
: I don’t want to cry anymore! I don’t want to cry!
scene makotoback30
: Well, too bad because I do!
scene black
I leave the classroom as well and retreat to the gym to meet back up with the rest of the girls.
There was no reason for me to be in that classroom any longer.
scene bedroom_night
But what I heard from Ami in the coming hours is that things worked out okay.
That Makoto went back home with Miku and has decided to take a little time off of school for the foreseeable future.
That she wouldn’t try running away again. And, if she ever felt the urge to, she’d talk to her mom first.
Of course, those are just words. And she may very well act out against them.
scene black
But something about the way they sound when released by the mouth of a third party makes me want to trust them a little more this time.
You see, the thing with words is that they’ll always be ephemeral.
And that, with how rapidly our lives and the world itself are changing, they’re really just air in the end.
And so Makoto will suffer as she remembers the life of the man she loved most.
But that’s fine.
Because if she listens hard enough, she’ll still be able to hear his voice in the whispers of the world itself.
And that gift from the sky should be enough to keep her grounded.

Makoto’s affection has increased to [makoto_love]!
But she’ll need some time alone for a while...
